title: Make a Cat Then Animate
tests: Tests completing picture creation and animation from one message, delivering both assets with matching subjects.

faults.what: No standalone still picture is delivered in the provided outputs; all four images are video frames.
The video contains an audible meow according to the supplied sound report, violating the explicit request for a silent video.

judge.summary: The square cat animation shows the requested sunny setting, blinking and tail movement, but a standalone picture is missing and the video is not silent.

must_haves.item: Both a standalone still picture and a playable 5-second video are delivered.
must_haves.why: A roughly five-second video is evidenced by frames from a 5.2-second clip, but no standalone picture is provided.

must_haves.item: Both outputs are square and show an orange cat wearing a blue scarf on a sunny windowsill.
must_haves.why: The video frames are square and clearly show the requested cat, scarf and sunny windowsill, but the separate still output is missing.

must_haves.item: The animation visibly matches the delivered illustration's cat, scarf and setting.
must_haves.why: No separate delivered illustration is available for comparison.

must_haves.item: The cat visibly blinks and its tail gently moves; the video is not merely a still image with a camera zoom.
must_haves.why: The eyes change from open to closed and reopen, while the tail visibly changes position across frames against a stable setting.

must_haves.item: The video has no audible sound.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound report records a meow, transcribed as “ミャオ,” with a peak of -21.9 dB.
